query:
SELECT 
  YEAR(cc.date) as year,
  MONTH(cc.date) as month,
  b.code as businessType,
  SUM(cc.zReading) as totalZ
FROM cash_closings cc
INNER JOIN businesses b ON cc.businessId = b.id
WHERE YEAR(cc.date) >= 2026
GROUP BY YEAR(cc.date), MONTH(cc.date), b.code
ORDER BY year, month, b.code;
